title: Jeremiah's prophecy about the 70-year captivity
description: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim's reign, Jeremiah receives a prophecy that Judah and its people will serve the king of Babylon for 70 years. Jeremiah reminds them that for 23 years the people have rejected the Lord's warnings through the prophets. Therefore, the Lord sends Nebuchadnezzar, His servant, to lay waste the land and silence all joy. When the seventy years are completed, the Lord will punish the king of Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans for their sin.
